remarks: Experience the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience in this beautifully updated multi-level townhouse-style condo located in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood.  Fully renovated, this expansive residence offers house-like living with sophisticated design, abundant natural light, and versatile spaces. Experience a dramatic sun-filled living space that showcases cathedral ceilings, hardwood floors, white oak staircase, recessed LED lighting, and a cozy wood-burning fireplace. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into a generous dining area, and an updated eat-in kitchen featuring granite counter tops.   The expansive primary suite occupies its own level and features a vaulted ceiling, double-door entry, a new full en-suite bath and spacious double closet, while an adjacent loft offers the perfect home office, reading nook, or creative retreat. A second bedroom is thoughtfully positioned with convenient access to a new full bath. Additional living space includes a soundproofed lower-level media room, gym, or optional guest suite, along with ample storage and finished garage.   Additional highlights include central air, updated bathrooms, new carpeting, one assigned parking space, plus abundant guest parking. Set within the well-maintained Tamarac complex with a beautifully landscaped courtyard, this turnkey home offers low-maintenance living just moments from Metro-North, shopping, dining, bus routes. New water heater and 2 new compressors.
